coverage_notes: Completed 12 targeted supplementary web searches focused on only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, disaster-related emergency-food distribution interruption, abrupt pantry/food-bank service reduction, and official SNAP/WIC access interruption. No new qualifying signal was verified within the observation window. Matthew's Hope service constraints in Central Florida were published earlier in the day and predated this window; Wildwood Soup Kitchen reporting described avoided closure and continued service; Hawai'i Food Basket hurricane-related closures were already retained in prior Food Line findings. Older grocery-store closures, routine promotions, donation appeals, resource notices, and generic food-insecurity coverage were excluded.
